_note: Which plugin each skill ships in. Prefix rules first, then explicit lists; anything unmatched goes to the default. build_marketplace.py prints unmatched names so a new skill gets placed on purpose.

bm-small-business.description: Small-business research on top of the Small Business Intelligence MCP server: teardowns, competitor maps, review and pricing reads, local visibility, buyer diligence, public records.

bm-reddit-research.description: What people actually say on Reddit, read free from a public archive on your own machine: pain points, demand checks, tool stacks, competitor chatter, customer language, thread digests.

bm-trading.description: A brokerage-account harness: pull positions, check stops, review the book, realized P&L, entry timing, intrinsic value, sector and catalyst screens.

bm-personas.description: Reasoning lenses as personas: a tech economist, an industrial-design critic, a product visionary, a sales closer, and synthetic customers to test an idea on.

bm-platforms.description: Working notes for the APIs and dashboards a small software business runs on: Clover, Square, Jobber, Stripe, Vercel, PostHog, Search Console, Google Calendar, Zoho, Apple apps, Chrome, Mixam, remote MCP servers.

bm-creative.description: Making things look right: AI art, riffs on a reference, study sheets, brand directions, deterministic video, wallpapers, photo touch-up, UI directions and mobile audits.

bm-creative-direction.description: How a creative round runs and what good looks like: ask the style once, vary the premise, rank the set, ship the prototype verbatim, reading-first layout, colour that tells the story, their words verbatim, and how to brainstorm without overreaching.
